name: Digging Through the Dirt
label: Quest
description: You search for the Embalmer’s missing heart in Duskwood at Raven Hill Cemetery. A mound marked Eliza hides a buried horror that will not stay dead.

clips.title: The story
paras: You search for the Embalmer’s missing heart in Duskwood at Raven Hill Cemetery. A mound marked Eliza hides a buried horror that will not stay dead.

At Raven Hill Cemetery, a patch of loose, freshly turned soil bears the name Eliza. Other graves in Duskwood lie open to scavengers or feral ghouls, but someone placed this earth with care. Digging below the topsoil uncovers the splintered boards of a coffin. It seals away the remnant the Embalmer meant to hide from the light of day.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You dig through the semi-loose dirt over the grave...and find the remains of a coffin.
Within the coffin you can feel the vibrating scrapes of clawed fingers and the gnashing of rotted teeth...
Will you open the coffin and retrieve the Embalmer's heart?
